edge_explainer: The screen's numbers verify - and verify BETTER than the screen carried: cash is $207.5M not $137.8M, net cash is 46% of cap not 32%, EV/EBIT is 1.25x not 1.6x, cap structure is zero options and zero warrants, and the FY25 audited Note 21 states the Group has NO off-balance-sheet contractual obligations, which REFUTES the build lane's named trap of $254M of committed Douta capex. The trap is one layer down and is a disclosure divergence, not an accounting one. Thor's only ever-published Segilola Mineral Reserve is the March-2021 DFS figure of 4,007kt @ 4.02 g/t = 518koz, restated unchanged in the April-2026 MD&A and the May-2026 corporate presentation with NO effective date - while the Douta table in the SAME MD&A carries 'effective date January 2026'. Against ~414-429koz poured since 2021 that reserve is ~87% depleted (~57-73koz contained left, 8-10 months at guidance); on tonnage it is more than 100% depleted (~4,320kt milled vs 4,007kt). No remaining mine life is stated in any company document, while 'extending the mine life' appears six times as a priority. Every physical observable agrees: mined ore grade 2.35 -> 1.71 -> 1.58 g/t, mining rate -28% q/q, pit 'getting narrower' (company verbatim), a 2.0Mt stockpile at 0.76 g/t described as 'approximately 2 years of process plant supply'. Separately, 80% of the FY24->FY25 EBITDA growth that put 'EBIT above its own peak' on the shelf is the gold price alone (+$96.4M of +$120.4M; volume +11%, cost +9%), the company is unhedged (Q2-26 realised $4,535 vs Q2 spot avg $4,514), and spot is now 14% below Q1-26's realised price - so the next two prints step down mechanically. Forward: open pit ends during 2027, plant then runs 0.76 g/t stockpile at ~22-24koz/yr, Douta first gold targeted H1-2028 - a 12-18 month revenue hole even on plan. And Douta is a strictly worse asset (1.03 g/t vs 4.02, LOM AISC $1,890 vs $927, reserve struck at $3,000/oz, a suspension roaster for 8 of its 12.6 years, 30% Senegal CIT plus 10% State free-carry, convention UNSIGNED and already slipped one half-year) which the company will fund out of peak-cycle cash - post-tax NPV is roughly its own $254M capex at ~$2,750/oz. Two further findings the shelf misses: (1) the Nigerian Pioneer Status tax holiday is disclosed but its EXPIRY DATE is disclosed NOWHERE - ESTMA 2025 independently corroborates the holiday (only $853,533 paid to the Federal Inland Revenue Service on $196M of net income) and quantifies the exposure at ~$60M/yr, ~30% of EBIT, on an undisclosed schedule; (2) the PFIC tag will break - passive share of FMV assets is 40.2% today on $207.5M of cash against $516M of FMV assets, crossing 50% within ~2 quarters and far worse in the 2027-28 production gap; the house conjunctive gate under-fires because Sec.1297(a) is disjunctive, so the asset test alone can trip it. Expected edge is +25% (E[FV] 68.4p vs 54.6p), which is real but the SHAPE disqualifies it now: the bear is permanent capital loss not drawdown, two-thirds of the base-case FV above net cash rests on the two things no company document discloses, the near-term revision path is mechanically negative, 370bp of touch demands a 2+ year hold this thesis cannot promise, the only verdict-changing catalyst (a UG reserve) has no date while the damaging one (FID) is targeted Q3-2026, and Q2-2026 financials print inside the 2-week no-blind-entry window.

ai_break_interaction: Entry does NOT require the AI-capex cycle to hold; gold benefits in most AI-BREAK end-states, so THX is one of the few names where the frozen 0.45 house call is a tailwind. But the de-rate prices the OPPOSITE (the reflation trade unwinding), and the first leg of a capex-driven break is typically a dollar/liquidity squeeze that takes gold down with everything else before the monetary response lifts it. THX carries 1.45x beta to gold in BOTH directions plus AIM microcap liquidity beta. It is a LAGGED hedge on a wasting asset - if the household wants the AI-break hedge the instrument is bullion or a long-reserve-life major, not a single-pit producer with nine months of declared reserve. Not averaged away: the hedge argument is the best thing about the name and is still not sufficient.
